title: TournamentCompleted
description: Published async contract on tournament.lifecycle.events (P7). Producer: tournament, via the second outbox-relay instance. Consumers: ranking (the placement rating of architecture §4.2) and analytics-workers (the bracket read model). Traces to docs/design/04-commands-events.md §4.2. The sample it validates is generated by the producer's own test (services/tournament ContractSampleTest), not written by hand. Envelope metadata travels as CloudEvents headers: the event's identity is ce-id = tournamentId:sequenceNumber and ce-type is com.unoarena.tournament.TournamentCompleted.v1 — a reverse-DNS URI, which is why every consumer classifies on the body's `type` instead. `champion` is nullable on purpose: a tournament everybody abandoned still has to end, and a null champion is that answer rather than a missing field.
